text:
neha-recruiter: Heads-up — new hire Sam's I-94 shows a different end date than the passport. We need the updated arrival record before the offer start. Can people-ops advise? @sara-peopleops

sam: Hey everyone — sorry for the scramble. I entered on F-1 in 2022 and my most recent admission was at the border in Feb. My passport stamp is 02/20/26 but I don't have the printed I-94 on me right now. Do we need the CBP I-94 printout or is the EAD enough?

sara-peopleops: Thanks @sam. We need a copy of your I-94 showing the most recent admission and admission class. Please download from https://i94.cbp.dhs.gov and upload to our onboarding portal. If you can't access the site, ping me and we can escalate to counsel.

neha-recruiter: Also flagging payroll — I-9 docs are required by the first day. The I-94 from CBP is acceptable as List A. If not available, we'll need an alternative List B + List C combo.

jason: For start date flexibility: we can move by one week if docs get held up. But laptop provisioning depends on I-9 clearance, so please prioritize.

maria-legal: Confirming — the I-94 is an acceptable List A document if it shows an unexpired admission that authorizes work. Note: the I-94 governs the admission date and length; passport expiration alone doesn't authorize work. Also if your admission class has employment restrictions (e.g., certain J statuses), we need to review DS-2019 or EAD. Sam, what's your current status/class?

sam: I'm on F-1 OPT STEM; my EAD card expires 07/15/26. I thought I already uploaded the EAD to Ripley — I'll re-upload the I-94 and both sides of the EAD scan now.

sara-peopleops: Perfect. For remote I-9 completion we need clear scans: front+back of EAD OR passport + I-94. Use our secure upload: https://onboard.redwood.ai/upload and choose "work auth docs". Don't include photos with glare.

sam: Uploaded i94.pdf, ead_front.jpg, ead_back.jpg — just did.

onboard-bot: Document upload received: i94.pdf, ead_front.jpg, ead_back.jpg. Status: pending review. :white_check_mark:

sara-peopleops: Reviewing now. Quick note — payroll sometimes rejects blurry EAD scans; your files look good at a glance. I'll mark the I-9 as "documents provided" and schedule the remote verification call. @jason, IT can ship laptop after verification?

jason: Yes, IT will ship once I-9 is cleared. Please cc me on the clearance note.

neha-recruiter: One more item — benefits eligibility depends on official hire date. If we shift start because of docs, confirm by EOD so benefits team can adjust enrollments.

maria-legal: Also FYI: if Sam plans international travel before EAD renewal is complete, that can jeopardize OPT status. Advise against travel without advance parole or a valid stamp.

sam: Not planning travel before start. Appreciate the heads-up.

sara-peopleops: I'll update the thread when I-9 verification is complete. Marking as in-progress until then.

onboard-bot: I-9 verification scheduled for 2024-06-12 15:00 PST.

sara-peopleops: (closing note) All documents look fine; will post final clearance after the verification meeting. Thanks everyone.
